passage.title: Northfield Community Centre — museum trip
passage.text: The Northfield Community Centre will run a day trip to the county museum on Saturday 14 June. The coach will leave the centre at 8:30 a.m. and return at about 6 p.m. The trip costs £12 for adults and £7 for children under twelve. Members may bring one guest at the member price. Lunch is not included, but the museum café sells sandwiches and hot drinks. Visitors should bring a waterproof jacket because part of the museum tour is outdoors. The centre cannot accept cancellations after Wednesday 11 June. To reserve a place, sign the list at the front desk and pay by Friday 6 June.

questions.stem: Which of the following is NOT stated in the trip notice?

options.label: A
options.text: The coach leaves the centre at 8:30 a.m.

options.label: B
options.text: The trip returns at about 6 p.m.

options.label: C
options.text: The museum café sells hot drinks.

questions.evidence: The trip costs £12 for adults and £7 for children under twelve.
questions.reasoning: The notice gives a £7 price for children under twelve, so they do not travel free. The other three statements appear in the notice.

option_reasoning.A: The notice states that the coach leaves the centre at 8:30 a.m. Under a NOT stem this supported statement is not the key.
option_reasoning.B: The notice states a return time of about 6 p.m.
option_reasoning.C: The notice states that the museum café sells hot drinks.
option_reasoning.D: The notice says children under twelve pay £7. 'Travel free' contradicts it; the phrase 'children under twelve' repeats passage words but the statement is false.

questions.stem: All of the following are true EXCEPT:

options.label: A
options.text: The trip takes place on Saturday 14 June.

options.label: B
options.text: Members may bring one guest at the member price.

options.label: C
options.text: Cancellations are accepted until Friday 6 June.

options.label: D
options.text: Visitors should bring a waterproof jacket.

questions.evidence: The centre cannot accept cancellations after Wednesday 11 June.
questions.reasoning: Cancellations stop after Wednesday 11 June. Friday 6 June is the payment deadline, not the cancellation deadline. The other three options are stated in the notice.

option_reasoning.A: The notice gives Saturday 14 June as the trip date.
option_reasoning.B: The notice says a member may bring one guest at the member price.
option_reasoning.C: This option mixes the payment date (Friday 6 June) with the cancellation rule. It repeats dates from the passage, but the statement is false; keyword overlap does not make it true.
option_reasoning.D: The notice asks visitors to bring a waterproof jacket.

questions.stem: How much does an adult pay for the trip?
questions.evidence: The trip costs £12 for adults and £7 for children under twelve.
questions.reasoning: The notice gives the adult price directly as £12.

option_reasoning.B: £12 is the adult price stated in the notice.
option_reasoning.C: £19 is not stated; it is the sum of the two prices, not a trip price.
